campbell.title: Campbell City Council — August 18, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered several administrative items, including selecting voting delegates for the 2026 League of California Cities annual conference, a resolution amending the city's agreement for city clerk services, and a grant acceptance presented by the police department's captain. The Council also took up an item on governance related to the BART Silicon Valley project.
keyTopics: Designation of voting delegates for the 2026 League of California Cities annual conference
Resolution amending the first amended agreement for city clerk services
Grant acceptance on behalf of the police department
Governance matters related to the BART Silicon Valley project

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — September 2, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council took up routine business including meeting minutes, check registers, and the Treasurer's Report, along with draft responses to two county Civil Grand Jury reports on pothole claims and VTA/BART oversight. The Council also considered a state bill on utility data transparency, a contract for a transportation impact fee study, an ad-hoc committee on alternative policing services, the future of the Saratoga Blossom Festival, and continued membership in the Cities Association of Santa Clara County.
keyTopics: Draft responses to Civil Grand Jury reports on pothole claims processing and VTA's oversight of BART Silicon Valley Phase II
Support for AB 1761, requiring utility data transparency on Power Charge Indifference Adjustment charges
$85,000 contract with Fehr and Peers for a Transportation Impact Fee study
Appointing two Council members to an ad-hoc committee on alternative policing services
Whether to continue the Saratoga Blossom Festival and Saratoga's ongoing role in the Cities Association of Santa Clara County

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — August 25, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council considered routine business including the Treasurer's Report and meeting minutes, along with contracts for the History Museum roof replacement and EV chargers at the Maintenance Yard. The Council also held a public hearing on a resident petition to rename Lee Street to Tubman Street, and reviewed two housing development proposals for new condominium units.
keyTopics: Public hearing on renaming Lee Street to Tubman Street
Vesting Tentative Map for 19 condominium units at 349 First Street
Vesting Tentative Map for 33 condominium units at Sherwood and Acacia Avenues
Construction contract for History Museum roof replacement and Maintenance Yard EV chargers
Draft responses to Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury reports on pothole claims and BART Silicon Valley Phase II oversight

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 1, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council met to approve routine meeting minutes and consider several administrative items, including vacating a public service easement on Cerro Vista and setting up preferential and time-limited parking rules in town. The Council also considered authorizing a consultant agreement related to executive recruitment services.
keyTopics: Vacating a public service easement at 15995 Cerro Vista
Establishing preferential permit parking and time-limited parking
Authorizing a consultant agreement for executive recruitment services
Approval of minutes from several August 2026 Town Council meetings

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — September 2, 2026
san-jose.summary: The San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole met to set the agenda for the upcoming September 15, 2026, meeting, since the September 8 meeting was canceled. The group also reviewed the public record for late August and considered a study session on financing tools for economic development infrastructure.
keyTopics: Review and cancellation of the September 8, 2026, final agenda
Planning of the September 15, 2026, draft agenda, including new items and time-certain scheduling
Review of the City Clerk's public record for August 20–27, 2026
Study session on infrastructure financing tools for economic development

mountain-view.title: Mountain View Youth Advisory Committee — August 31, 2026
mountain-view.summary: Mountain View's Youth Advisory Committee met to take public comments, do a team-building exercise, and get oriented on meeting rules under the Brown Act and Robert's Rules of Order. Members also discussed their role on the committee and began brainstorming ideas for their work plan for the upcoming fiscal year.
keyTopics: Public comment period (Oral Communications)
Team-building activity
Orientation on the Brown Act and Robert's Rules of Order
Discussion of the Youth Advisory Committee's role
Brainstorming for the FY 2026-27 work plan

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — August 25, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council held a special closed session meeting followed by a public session featuring a presentation on the CleanWater Program update. No regular legislative business was listed on this agenda.
keyTopics: Closed session held prior to the public meeting
Presentation on the CleanWater Program update

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — September 1, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council held a closed session followed by a report on its outcome. The public portion of the agenda also included information about the city's lobbyist registration and reporting requirements under municipal law.
keyTopics: Report out from closed session
Lobbyist registration and reporting requirements under the city's lobbying ordinance

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — August 25, 2026
santa-clara.summary: This Santa Clara City Council meeting was held in a hybrid format, with one Councilmember participating remotely from India. The agenda excerpt covers meeting logistics, including remote participation details and instructions for submitting public comment, rather than substantive policy items.
keyTopics: Councilmember Chahal's remote participation from Panchkula, India
Hybrid meeting format with in-person and Zoom/phone access options
Procedures for submitting written public comment before the meeting

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 1, 2026
milpitas.summary: The City Council, acting as the Successor Agency to the former Redevelopment Agency, considered administrative actions related to winding down redevelopment-related finances. This included confirming which city officials serve as officers of the Successor Agency and authorizing the sale of refunding bonds to replace older redevelopment debt.
keyTopics: Confirming and designating city officials as officers of the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency
Authorizing issuance and sale of 2026 Tax Allocation Refunding Bonds to refinance existing redevelopment agency debt

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Economic Development Committee — August 26, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto Economic Development Committee considered a staff presentation on the city's Business Retention, Expansion, and Attraction (BRE/A) Strategy, aimed at supporting local businesses. Staff also presented the Economic Development Activity Report for August 2026, covering recent economic development efforts in the city.
keyTopics: Business Retention, Expansion, and Attraction (BRE/A) Strategy presentation
Economic Development Activity Report for August 2026
